name: Codex Bridge
description: Run Codex review, adversarial review, and second-pass handoffs from Claude Code while keeping ThumbGate reliability memory and pre-action gates in the loop.
longDescription:
Ships **4 skills** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (4): `agent-memory` (Recall past mistakes and capture feedback so your agent stops repeating errors), `solve-architecture-autonomy` (Automated skill to handle architecture, autonomy, crisis, debug, deployment, error, execution, external-assessment, feedback, inefficiency, negative, railway, revenue, roi,…), `thumbgate` (Pre-action gates for AI coding agents — capture thumbs-up/down feedback, generate prevention rules, and block known-bad patterns before…), `thumbgate-feedback` (Capture thumbs feedback and apply prevention rules before coding)
- **MCP servers** (1): `thumbgate`

Installs with `claude plugin install codex-bridge@claude-community` from `IgorGanapolsky/ThumbGate`.
